panels.beat: The Ember Vault drops beneath one chain bridge; Elian and Mira are tiny adult silhouettes crossing toward the sealed bell lift.

copy: The Hollow Meridian was not scheduled to wake for another six years. The chains disagree with the schedule.

panels.beat: Elian pauses in mature profile with one hand on the hooked shortblade while his weak starting status hangs in reserved negative space.

copy: ELIAN VOSS · LV 3 XP 60 / 100 CLASS · SALVAGER HP 44 / 52 · QI 31 / 40 BREATH SEED I

panels.beat: Elian and Mira trade a dry warning; the failing bridge anchor remains visible between their adult faces.

copy: That anchor is singing. Tell me you still have both Iron Seals before the bridge decides to become a ladder.
Both seals. One bad rib. And a professional opinion that we should stop standing on the thing that is singing.

panels.beat: The ivory Belljaw Warden climbs onto the far platform and opens its bell-shaped jaw seam.

copy: Professional opinion revised. The bridge has a landlord, and it looks offended by our rent.

panels.beat: Side-on geography fixes Belljaw at the right bridge mouth, Mira center-left, Elian behind, and one intact anchor below.

copy: One intact anchor behind us. One boss ahead. If it reaches the center, the bridge twists and the lift stays sealed.

panels.beat: Belljaw charges right-to-left and kicks bridge boards upward behind its foreclaws.

copy: Then it never reaches center. Read the legs; I will make the head believe I am the problem.

panels.beat: Mira plants the split shield and drives her spear into the charge line.

copy: Now, Elian. I can redirect the charge, not negotiate with it.

panels.beat: Belljaw clamps Mira's spear and wrenches it sideways while her planted boot skids.

copy: THOOM

panels.beat: Elian extends one hand; a single ember fault line reveals the boss's ankle seam.

copy: The ankle seam is real, but it only stays loaded for six seconds. That is less generous than I hoped.
FAULT SIGHT I ACTIVE · −12 QI · CD 20s ONE VERIFIED FAULT · 6s

panels.beat: Elian slides left-to-right beneath the jaw, using the chain rail as one step toward the ankle.

copy: Six seconds is a career in salvage. Move before the profession changes its mind.

panels.beat: A ceramic forelimb backhands Elian into a hanging chain before his hookblade lands.

copy: Contact never happened. Forelimb changed angle after the jaw clamp—remember that when it comes again.

panels.beat: Elian hangs alone from the chain, guarding his cracked left rib as the collarbone ember fissure closes.

copy: Stop turning injuries into field notes. Your breath is folding at the collarbone, and I cannot shield you from inside.
You can shield the bridge. I need one complete pattern and something hot enough to force the second circuit.

panels.beat: In an extreme close-up, Elian crushes his only Spark Talisman while two Iron Seals remain untouched at his belt.

copy: That talisman was our exit plan.
It was a possibility. You are an actual person holding a boss by the teeth. I am spending the possibility.

panels.beat: Breath Seed II opens as one restrained ember ring; Elian coils against the chain with a newly stable breath.

copy: Three broken breaths taught me where the fourth one had to go.
BREATH SEED II GATE · BROKEN BREATH COMPLETED QI MAX 40 → 48 · +8 RESTORE FAULT STEP I UNLOCKED

panels.beat: Mira pins the bell jaw while Elian's Fault Step launches bottom-to-top through the ankle seam in one clear impact.

copy: Jaw pinned. Fault exposed. Take the line I made and finish what you started.

panels.beat: Belljaw lies collapsed inside the vault; Elian sits injured, Mira stands watch, and the Rare Cinder-Key rests in front.

copy: We kept the anchor, lost the talisman, and gained a key that wants to redesign my career. That feels aggressively fair.
Fair would include a medic. Stand slowly, or I will count carrying you as another inventory decision.
LEVEL 4 · XP 45 / 140 HP 20 / 56 · QI 3 / 48 CINDER-KEY · RARE ×1 QUEST COMPLETED · CLASS OPTIONS OPEN

panels.beat: Mira kneels to bind Elian's ribs while he tries and fails to stand without her help.

copy: The rib is not a metaphor. You cannot breathe around it forever just because the Ledger has not objected yet.
I was hoping the dignified silence would imply recovery. Apparently it only implies poor medical judgment.

panels.beat: The intact anchor hums above the void as both adults assess the cost of retreating through unstable chainworks.

copy: Retreat meant crossing the same broken chain with less Qi, fewer options, and a waking bell below us.

panels.beat: The Cinder-Key wakes a narrow class terminal showing two paths without selecting either one.
Elian studies the safer Kiln Appraiser option while Mira watches his breathing rather than the menu.

copy: Do not choose the dangerous class because pain made the safer one feel cowardly. Choose it only if it changes the next fight.
The Appraiser would tell us what the ruins are worth. The Adept might tell us where the ruins intend to kill us.

panels.beat: Mira presses one Iron Seal back into Elian's palm instead of letting him spend it on pain relief.

copy: Keep the seal. I would rather fight with a bent plan than watch you purchase one clean minute.

panels.beat: A distant bell pulse travels upward through the vault cables toward the public surface lift.

copy: That pulse is climbing toward the city.
Then our volume problem is no longer getting out. It is reaching the crown before the bell does.

panels.beat: Elian and Mira step into the rising bell lift together, damaged gear and adult silhouettes clean against the pale door.

copy: You know the lift may refuse a classless Salvager at the next gate.
Then choose after you can see the price clearly. For once, let tomorrow make its own bad decision.

panels.beat: The lift closes on a new Ledger offer: choose a class and reach the Hollow Meridian crown before the Bell Regent ascends.

copy: CHOOSE THE CRACK · OFFERED SELECT A CLASS PATH REACH THE HOLLOW MERIDIAN CROWN BELL REGENT ASCENT · ACTIVE

panels.beat: The bell lift opens into vast Chainworks where suspended gears and three broken spans frame a narrow route downward.

copy: The Chainworks had been built to move bells the size of houses. Today they were moving people like loose change.

panels.beat: Elian's L4 status and two class paths appear beside his injured stance, with XP and class prerequisites clearly visible.

copy: LEVEL 4 · XP 45 / 140 CLASS OPTIONS · 2 UNSPENT POINTS · 1 INJURY · CRACKED RIB

panels.beat: Mira compares the Appraiser's safety to the Adept's combat risk while tightening Elian's rib binding.

copy: Kiln Appraiser gives you safer refinement, better sale values, and no reason to put your ribs near another charging animal.
Faultline Adept gives us a route through a dungeon designed by someone who considered stairs a moral weakness.

panels.beat: Elian binds the Cinder-Key into the Faultline Adept seal; one ember fracture motif crosses his short coat.

copy: That is not an answer about survival.
It is. I am choosing the class that turns survival into something the whole party can use.

panels.beat: A quiet close-up shows his hookblade hand settling into a lower diagonal class stance.

copy: The seal did not make me stronger. It made every weak thing in the room suddenly honest.

panels.beat: Fault Hook I appears as a narrow skill card with cost, cooldown, legal targets, and acquisition source.

copy: FAULT HOOK I ACTIVE · −10 QI · CD 12s SELF / UNSECURED OBJECT ONLY SOURCE · FAULTLINE ADEPT

panels.beat: A trapped adult delver calls from a dangling maintenance cage while a rescue quest opens.

copy: Do not cut the cage free. The little white bastards chewed the brake pins first, and the lower chain is carrying everything.
We heard you. Keep both hands inside and give us your name after gravity loses interest.

panels.beat: Three ivory Cinder Mites sever the cage chain pins and race along separate links.

copy: KLANG

panels.beat: Wide geography fixes the cage below, Mira on the central beam, Elian above, and the mites moving toward the final pin.

copy: Three mites, four pins, one live chain. Mira, if I move the cage, can you own the weight for five seconds?
I can own it for eight. Use six and leave me two for regretting the arithmetic.

panels.beat: Mira wedges her split shield under the cage chain and bears its weight.
Elian reads the single pin that carries the cage and marks the safe chain fault above it.
A mite cuts the marked chain early, dropping the cage and reversing Elian's plan.

copy: It cut early. The marked chain is no longer the safe one.
Then stop chasing the mark. Chase the person falling under it.
KLANG

panels.beat: Elian fires Fault Hook into the overhead fault, pulling his own body across the falling gap.

copy: Fault Hook could not pull a living target. It could pull the idiot willing to meet one halfway.

panels.beat: He swings beneath the beam with the hookblade held clear of the rescued delver.
Elian catches the cage latch as Mira redirects its weight into her shield anchor.

copy: If this is the rescue plan, I preferred not knowing it.
That makes two of us. Hold the latch; Mira is about to make the rest look intentional.

panels.beat: One Iron Seal sits in Elian's open palm beside the unstable span and the unspent second seal.

copy: The seal is our last clean bridge repair after this. Spend it only if you accept what cannot be repaired later.
A future bridge is hypothetical. The adult hanging from this one has already introduced himself.
IRON SEAL ×2 STABILIZE SPAN? COST · 1 SEAL · IRREVERSIBLE CONFIRM · YES

panels.beat: He drives the seal into the chain socket; the rescued delver reaches stable footing.
The mites flee through a vertical gear throat as Elian and Mira chase along rotating chain teeth.

copy: Mites entering the gear throat. Left rotation, rising teeth, no room for another heroic swing.
Good. I have recently developed a professional relationship with narrow mistakes.

panels.beat: Fault Step redirects Elian around one turning gear and into the lead mite's path.
Mira closes the escape with a flat shield strike; the remaining mites collapse in one readable line.

copy: Lead mite down. Two pinned against the brake plate.
Then do not smash the carapaces. Orin can turn intact shells into something less determined to murder us.
KLANG

panels.beat: Three carapaces and a tempered Chainspool lie in a clean loot arrangement.
The rescued delver identifies an Ash Crown shortcut and refuses Elian's attempt to call the rescue incidental.

copy: Ash Crown opened a private line through Verdigris. They call it a shortcut because 'planned structural betrayal' lacks charm.
Which means the Regent waking early is not an accident. It is somebody's extraction schedule.

panels.beat: The next bell lift opens toward the Glass Gallery, its pale mineral ribs visible below.

copy: Class selected, civilian breathing, one seal left. Try to enjoy an outcome before cataloging the next disaster.
I will enjoy it in the lift. Quietly, where the chains cannot hear confidence.

panels.beat: Quest completion, Free Delvers reputation, inventory, and 130/140 XP reconcile in a compact end-state menu.

copy: FAULTLINE ADEPT · ACTIVE XP 130 / 140 IRON SEAL ×1 · CARAPACE ×3 FREE DELVERS +4 · TRUST +2

panels.beat: The Glass Gallery descends through dark mineral ribs and pale echo planes toward a brass survey vestibule.
Orin Pell, a broad light-complexioned adult forge-medic, scans Elian's cracked rib through a brass-rimmed monocle.

copy: Cracked rib, improvised binding, and enough heat damage to season a pan. Which of you called this a successful descent?
He did. I called it the minimum evidence required to keep yelling at him.

panels.beat: Orin tells Elian that surviving badly is not a build while Mira inventories the remaining medical stock.

copy: I survived, completed the quest, and brought a medically interesting key.
Surviving badly is not a build. It is a debt with symptoms.

panels.beat: A Resin Suture closes the fracture under Orin's gloved hands; the item counter falls to zero.

copy: This suture is my last fracture treatment. It closes the rib; it does not refund whatever lesson you refuse to learn.
RESIN SUTURE · TEMPERED FRACTURE TREATMENT · +24 HP QUANTITY 1 → 0 SOURCE · ORIN PELL

panels.beat: The Ledger offers Three Breaths: hold Pressure Breath through a live resonance without abandoning formation.

copy: Three live resonance phases while injured? That training quest reads like malpractice with a progress bar.
Correct. Which is why he practices here, and not while something is chewing through you.

panels.beat: Orin demonstrates collarbone, sternum, and diaphragm timing with three restrained hand taps.

copy: Collarbone receives. Sternum carries. Diaphragm releases. If you force phase two, the pressure returns through the lung.

panels.beat: A cultivation menu shows Breath Seed II, the three-phase gate, 32 Qi cost, Glass Lung risk, and 52 max Qi.

copy: BREATH SEED II GATE · THREE PRESSURE PHASES COST · 32 QI FAILURE · GLASS LUNG

panels.beat: Elian's first practice breath breaks on the second phase and he coughs into his wrapped hand.

copy: Second phase keeps collapsing when I protect the rib.
The rib is repaired. Your body has not received the paperwork. Give it a slower first breath.

panels.beat: Mira quietly resets his shoulders while Orin refuses to reduce the gate.

copy: She is right, which I record only because it irritates both of us efficiently.

panels.beat: Training completion tips Elian across Level 5; one unspent point remains visibly unallocated.

copy: The level arrived because I finished the gate, not because the pain looked dramatic.

panels.beat: A six-legged Glassback Skitter drops from a mineral rib, its transparent wedge carapace catching one pale edge.

copy: Glassback above the third rib. Six legs, one shell, and a gallery built to repeat every mistake.

panels.beat: Wide geometry fixes the Skitter ahead, Mira at the brass rail, Elian left, and Orin behind cover.

copy: It pulses in threes. Orin, stay behind the brass rail. Mira, give the first note somewhere empty to go.
You get one read before the echo returns. Make it useful, not beautiful.
SHNK

panels.beat: The Skitter emits the first of three flat resonance arcs through the narrow gallery.
Mira angles her shield so the arc exits into an empty mineral bay.
Elian reads a bright fault beneath the carapace, but it shifts with the creature's second note.

copy: The fault moved with the note. The shell is not armor; it is a rotating map.

panels.beat: His hookblade strikes empty glass as the weak point migrates to the opposite leg.

Good. Keep the lane; I will turn inside it.

panels.beat: Fault Step II pivots from the guard knee to the severed brake housing.
A guard blade cuts Mira's left upper arm before she can anchor the Crownfork.

copy: Left arm cut. Crownfork still anchored, but I cannot recover the spear alone.

panels.beat: Sable takes Mira's exposed side without asking for forgiveness or command.

copy: Then I take the exposed side. Do not mistake useful timing for an apology.
I will schedule forgiveness after we stop falling.
THOOM

panels.beat: Orin's rebuilt Kiln Satchel powers Suture Pulse and closes the fresh arm wound without erasing strain.

copy: Suture Pulse crossing. Wound closed, arm strained, twelve health accounted. Please remain attached to the platform.

panels.beat: Mira binds Elian and Sable into Lockstep Brace as the platform drops.

copy: Lockstep all four. Mira anchors, Sable clears, Orin holds cable, I carry the faults into the brake.

panels.beat: Fault Bastion: Crosslock drives linked faults into the brake housing and throws the guards clear of the lift.

copy: Crosslock. On the cable's second recoil.

panels.beat: The platform catches on one cable; Mira's arm hangs bound while the public lift remains far below.

copy: THOOM

panels.beat: Guard XP and ascent progress bring Elian to 300/320 without an early level-up.
The Crownshaft cap opens and reveals the underside of the enormous Bell Regent.

copy: That is not a mechanism above us.
No. It is the Bell Regent's underside, and it just heard the forge.

panels.beat: The Regent wakes early and tears one complete platform ring from the shaft.

copy: Platform ring gone. Regent descending. Whatever assault we planned has become a deadline.

panels.beat: Strike the Silence replaces the incomplete assault: defeat the Regent before it reaches the public lift.

copy: STRIKE THE SILENCE · ACCEPTED XP 300 / 320 PUBLIC LIFT · AT RISK BELL REGENT · LV 12

panels.beat: The Bell Regent towers through the final chamber, four long legs spanning ivory platforms above the public lift cable.

copy: The Regent had no throne. It had four legs, a city beneath it, and a note that made every structure kneel.

panels.beat: Opening status shows Elian L7 300/320, 28/75 HP, 12/76 Qi, Channel I, injuries, Relic loadout, and active quest.

copy: ELIAN VOSS · LEVEL 7 XP 300 / 320 HP 28 / 75 · QI 12 / 76 RIFT TEMPERER · CHANNEL I

panels.beat: Elian assigns Mira the yoke, Sable the escape lane, Orin the lift cable, and himself the hostile note.

copy: Mira owns the yoke. Sable owns the escape lane. Orin owns the public cable. I take the note and return a fault.
You take the note only after it finishes. No early draw, no private sacrifice, no improvising a funeral into the plan.

panels.beat: Wide geography fixes the Regent above, party on three platforms, public cable center, and the fourth-meridian door behind.

copy: Fourth-meridian door behind the rear leg. Ash Crown wanted the Regent core, but the sponsor wanted whatever that door seals.
Excellent. We can investigate institutional greed after the building-sized bell stops descending.

panels.beat: The Regent sounds one visible ring that bends every free cable toward its hollow face.

copy: First note bends free cable toward the face aperture. Anchor anything you need to keep.

panels.beat: The central platform folds, forcing Mira and Sable onto opposite sides of the public cable.

copy: Central platform folding. Sable, opposite side; give me a lane under the injured arm.

panels.beat: Mira drives Crownfork into the crown yoke while Sable opens a Severing Lane under her injured arm.

copy: Lane open. One controlled debt stack, no default.
Crownfork entering the yoke. Elian, wait for the load to settle.

panels.beat: The Regent lifts one leg and uses the skewed yoke to throw Mira across the cable.

copy: The Regent is using her anchor as a lever. Mira, release before it throws you across the cable.
KLANG

panels.beat: Mira catches the cable with her shield hand; the bound left arm cannot lift the spear.

copy: Too late. Shield hand on cable. Left arm will not lift the spear.

panels.beat: Elian reads two linked faults, one in the yoke and one in the note-distorted platform.

copy: Two linked faults: yoke joint and distorted platform. Neither remains valid through the whole note.

panels.beat: Two Crown Guards enter the lane; their defeat supplies 35 XP and crosses the Level 8 threshold once.

copy: Guards entering Sable's lane. Clear them quickly; the Ledger will level you without healing what the boss breaks.

panels.beat: Level 8 raises HP/Qi maximums, grants one point, and carries 15/400 XP without clearing injuries.

copy: Level eight expanded the vessel. It did not refill courage, forgive injuries, or choose the next step.
LEVEL 8 XP CARRY · 15 / 400 HP MAX 75 → 83 · QI MAX 76 → 80 UNSPENT POINTS +1

panels.beat: Sable spends one controlled debt stack to cut a lane from Mira to Orin rather than toward the boss.

copy: I can cut toward the Regent.
Cut toward Orin. Saving the cable is the fight, even when the boss is louder.

panels.beat: Orin anchors the rebuilt kiln line to the public cable and sends Suture Pulse to Elian.

copy: Cable anchored. Suture Pulse to Elian, twelve health. That is the last clean heat cycle in the rebuilt satchel.

panels.beat: After surviving the complete hostile note, Elian places Rift Mark on the Regent's nonliving yoke joint.

copy: Full hostile pattern survived. Rift Mark on the nonliving yoke—four seconds from contact.

panels.beat: The Regent stamps through Elian's platform and breaks his route to the marked yoke.

copy: Platform gone. Your marked route is gone with it.
KLANG

panels.beat: Elian falls beside the public cable with the mark expiring above him.

copy: Not gone. Bent into the public cable.

panels.beat: Inside the second hostile note, Elian accepts its cadence and opens Breath Channel II in two restrained ember arcs.

copy: I had tried to defeat the bell by holding my own rhythm. Channel II opened when I accepted its cadence without surrendering mine.

panels.beat: A cultivation menu records the hostile-resonance gate, 76→86 max Qi, captured restoration, and Meridian Shear risk avoided.

copy: Two stable arcs. Ninety maximum Qi. Meridian Shear avoided by an amount I refuse to call comfortable.
BREATH CHANNEL II HOSTILE CADENCE · ACCEPTED QI MAX 80 → 90 · +46 RESTORE MERIDIAN SHEAR · AVOIDED

panels.beat: Fault Step II follows the bent cable to Mira, then pivots at the linked yoke fault.

copy: Fault Step follows the bent cable, pivots at the yoke. Mira, I need your anchor for the second draw.
You have it. Sable clears the return; Orin locks the city line. Nobody carries this alone.
KLANG

panels.beat: Mira, Sable, and Orin lock the cable and yoke so Elian's two-stage draw has one unambiguous target.

copy: Escape lane closed. Attack lane open. For once, the difference is voluntary.
Cable tension stable. Do the spectacular thing before my equipment develops another opinion.

panels.beat: Rift Draw III severs the yoke and carries through the linked crown joint in the volume's clearest vertical spectacle.

copy: Crosslock complete. Strike the silence.

panels.beat: The Bell Regent collapses away from the public cable; Crown Shard, Meridian Seal, and Sponsor Writ resolve with boss credit.

copy: Boss credit confirmed. Public cable intact. Mira, please tell me the enormous bell is finished moving.
It is. Sit down before the Ledger mistakes standing for consent to another quest.

panels.beat: A CH01→CH10 comparison closes over the surviving lift as the sealed fourth-meridian door opens behind the adult party.

copy: The fourth door is opening, and the sponsor's writ carries a city seal.
Then the next volume begins with evidence. This one ends with everyone still here to read it.
CH01 → CH10 LEVEL 3 → 8 · XP 60/100 → 295/400 SALVAGER → RIFT TEMPERER SEED I → CHANNEL II HOOKBLADE → REGENTBREAKER FREE DELVERS 0 → 58
